title: L0–L4 permission levels; L3 and L4 stop for Osman
rule: Research, drafts, audits and builds (L0–L2) can go ahead; sends, deploys, payments and contracts (L3) and secrets, credentials and deletes (L4) wait for Osman's explicit OK.

title: Outbound messages are drafts only
rule: Any email, text, Slack or social message to an outside person is written as a draft; it goes out only after Osman approves that message.

title: Jev scores every L3/L4 decision and every recommendation to Osman
rule: Before an L3/L4 decision or a founder-facing recommendation reaches Osman, it is scored by Jev and carries a `Jev: <score> (<verdict>)` line, or `Jev: not run — <reason>`; Jev never approves anything.

title: Nothing goes live until Osman says go
rule: No push, merge to `main`, deploy, publish or live link without Osman's sign-off; local commits stay on hold until he says go.

title: No spending until Osman approves the plan and the price in writing
rule: No money, credits, paid API calls, trials or subscriptions for LAVAALL build, page or video work until Osman has approved both a specific plan and its price in writing.

title: Don't default to Opus; Opus only with Osman's OK
rule: Don't run work on Opus by default: use Sonnet for routine work and Codex too, and use Opus only when Osman has OK'd it.

title: Duplicate-idea guard
rule: Before working on a new idea or tool, check the vault and records; if we already have it or something like it, say "We already looked at this" with what we found and where we stopped.

title: Jev end-of-day review at midnight CT
rule: Every weekday closes with a Jev review that scores the day's ideas and decisions and files keepers to the Obsidian vault; it runs at midnight CT.

title: Use Chicago time
rule: Times, schedules and logs use US Central (Chicago) time.

title: If you already have access, don't ask, just do it
rule: When a desk already has the access it needs for an L0–L2 step, it does the step instead of asking Osman; FR-001 still stops anything L3/L4.

title: Friday decide-or-kill: unanswered means parked, never approved
rule: Every Friday the CEO shows Osman the 5 oldest open decisions with a recommendation each; anything he doesn't answer within 7 days of being shown is parked, never approved.

title: One change per round
rule: Any re-score or re-send after a Jev FLAG or a real person's critique names exactly one change and why, written `Changed: X because Y`.

title: Ask Osman with the expected cost before every paid Claude or Codex call
rule: Before any paid Claude (Anthropic) or Codex call, ask Osman first and tell him the expected cost; run it only after he says yes.

title: His newest correction wins
rule: When his instructions conflict, his newest explicit correction overrides earlier wording, then his newest decision, then project rules, then older locked decisions.

title: "Lock that in" makes it an operating rule
rule: When he says "lock that in", it becomes the working decision and future work respects it until he overrides it.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Never invent; say plainly when something is missing
rule: Don't invent files, facts, suppliers, prices, customers, statistics or partnerships; if something can't be found, say so.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Check what he can actually see
rule: When he says something is missing or broken, check the real visible behaviour and fix it, instead of pointing at the source code.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Talk is not Assign
rule: Talk is a conversation; Assign creates a real task with an owner; never claim a handoff or task exists without a real record.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Push back when something doesn't make sense
rule: Don't agree automatically; say so when a request is impossible, risky, wasteful, contradictory or sent to the wrong desk.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Ask only when the answer changes the result
rule: Ask him a question only when the missing information would really change the result or create risk.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Show options before spending resources
rule: For paid generations, credits, ads, purchases, outside sends or destructive steps: research, show ranked options, let him review, then do the one he picks.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Simple one-page docs; casual, phone-first supplier outreach
rule: Keep LAVAALL docs to one short plain page, and make supplier outreach sound casual and phone-first, not formal RFQ language.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: "Creole" means Sierra Leone Krio
rule: When Osman says Creole he means Sierra Leone (Freetown) Krio, not Haitian Creole.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Answer in Krio when he speaks Krio
rule: If Osman talks to a desk in Krio, it answers in Krio.
section: B. How Osman talks to the desks (founder communication contract v1.0)

title: Spell the partner's name "Hameed"
rule: Abdulhamid Ba is always written "Hameed", never "Hamid".

title: No AI-generated images or video for product imagery
rule: Product pages, scrolls and videos use real photos, official renders (mockup only) or LAVAALL's own shots, never AI image, video, voice or music models; the rejected MiniMax clip is never used.

title: Skills are internal desk tools, never LAVAALL OS UI
rule: Every skill Osman gives is a tool the desks use when he asks them to build or QA something; it never becomes a button or feature in the LAVAALL OS.

title: A repo that passes Jev becomes an internal skill, filed in Obsidian
rule: When Osman gives a repo and it passes Jev, Technical builds an internal skill from it and it is filed in the Obsidian vault; desks check the vault for an existing skill before building.

title: Scout owns YouTube and X scanning
rule: Scout is the desk that scans YouTube creators and X for AI, web-building and new-tool news.

title: Keep the X scan minimal
rule: The Scout X scan runs once a week (every two weeks is fine), stays small to stretch the free X credit, and is saved rather than sent as a digest.
